units.source_text: 对局期间，名人的夫人从来不曾待在他身旁，唯独这天，她寸步不离地守候在隔壁房间里，细心观察名人的动静。

en.t: During matches, the Master's wife had never stayed at his side, but on this day alone she remained close by in the adjoining room, watching his every movement with care.

units.source_text: 她不是在观赏对弈，是无法将目光从生病的丈夫身上移开。

en.t: She was not watching the game itself; she simply could not take her eyes off her ailing husband.
